tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (the end customers of the cleaning company) with paging, search and change-date filters. API: GET /GetCustomers.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with contact and location details. API: GET /GetCustomerDetails.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (the cleaning company's client accounts) with paging, search and change-date filters. API: GET /GetClients.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_get_location
tools.description: Get one location (cleaning site) by id, with address and service instructions. API: GET /GetLocationDetails.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_properties
tools.description: List properties (buildings or sites). API: GET /GetProperties.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (cleaners and staff) with paging, search and change-date filters. API: GET /GetEmployees.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id. API: GET /GetEmployeeDetail.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_employee_punches
tools.description: List employee time punches (clock in and out) for a date range. API: GET /GetEmployeePunches.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_get_payroll
tools.description: Get payroll data for a date range, optionally for one employee, client or customer. API: GET /GetPayroll.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_quality_controls
tools.description: List quality control (QC) inspections with paging and filters. API: GET /GetQCs.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_get_quality_control
tools.description: Get one QC inspection by reference number, with scores and notes. API: GET /GetQCDetail.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_areas
tools.description: List areas (rooms or zones inside a location). API: GET /GetAreas.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_area_types
tools.description: List area types, optionally by title. API: GET /GetAreaTypes.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_area_scans
tools.description: List area scans (barcode or tag scans that prove an area was visited). API: GET /GetAreaScans.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_employee_scans
tools.description: List employee scans (an employee's scan at an area). API: GET /GetEmployeeScans.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_work_orders
tools.description: List work orders with paging and filters (status, type, billable, completion date). API: GET /GetWOs.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_get_work_order
tools.description: Get one work order by id, with its full detail. API: GET /GetWODetail.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_supply_orders
tools.description: List supply orders (cleaning supplies ordered for sites). API: GET /GetSupplyOrders.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with paging, search and change-date filters. API: GET /GetSuppliers.

tools.name: janitorialmanager_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id. API: GET /GetSupplierDetail.
